raw_sections.Description:
Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 Gaming Laptop is a gaming laptop featuring a Intel Core™ i7-13645HX, 14C (6P + 8E) / 20T, P-core up to 4.9GHz, E-core up to 3.5GHz, 24MB Intel® Smart Cache processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ 4050 6GB GDDR6, Boost Clock 2370MHz, TGP 105W, 194 AI TOPS graphics, 1x 16GB SODIMM DDR5-4800 memory, 512GB SSD M.2 2242 PCIe® 4.0x4 NVMe® storage, and a 15.6" FHD (1920x1080) IPS 300nits Anti-glare, 100% sRGB, 144Hz, G-SYNC® display, making it a gaming laptop available in Egypt through Compumarts.
